title: IT Administrator
description:
IT Administrator
- Paris
Full-Time
Apply Now
About
Zama is the fastest-growing confidentiality protocol for on-chain finance.
By leveraging Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE), it enables digital assets to be issued, managed, and traded privately on existing public blockchains such as Ethereum and Solana.
Founded by FHE pioneer Dr. Pascal Paillier and entrepreneur Dr. Rand Hindi, Zama brings together one of the world’s largest teams of FHE researchers and engineers and supports a global ecosystem of developers building confidential applications. zama.org
Job Description
Zama builds privacy infrastructure for onchain finance, and the way we run our own systems needs to reflect that. As the company scales, we are building out a dedicated IT function with security at its core. We are looking for an IT Administrator to join our IT lead, share ownership of the function, and make sure the team gets fast, reliable support while the longer-term security projects keep moving.
What you'll do
Own day-to-day IT support: Handle help desk requests across the company, from device issues to access problems, and resolve them quickly and clearly. Be the person colleagues trust to get them back to work.
Manage the Mac fleet: Provision, configure, maintain, and retire company Macs. Keep devices patched, compliant, and consistently configured through Jamf.
Drive the Jamf and Okta rollouts: Support the deployment of device management and identity tooling across the company, including onboarding users, handling the questions and issues each rollout generates, and refining configurations as we learn.
Run identity and access management: Manage onboarding and offboarding, application access, and permissions in Okta, with least-privilege and security best practices as the default.
Automate the repetitive: Identify recurring help desk requests and reduce them through automation, self-service, and better documentation.
Strengthen our security posture: Contribute to IT security projects alongside our IT lead, and bring a security mindset to every change you make to our systems.
Document and improve: Build and maintain clear internal documentation and processes so the IT function scales with the company.
Preferred Experience
5-8 years of experience in an IT administrator or similar role.
Hands-on experience managing a Mac fleet.
Experience with Jamf and/or Okta; experience with both is a strong plus.
A strong security mindset, with an instinct for least privilege, device compliance, and protecting company and user data.
Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment, where priorities shift and you balance reactive support with longer-term projects.
Professional fluency in English (C1 minimum). Bilingual French/English is strongly preferred.
Clear, patient communication with colleagues of all technical levels, written and verbal.
Based in Europe, ideally in Paris.
Nice-to-have
Jamf certifications.
Experience scripting or automating IT workflows.
A degree in computer science, IT, or a related field.
Recruitment Process
📋 Step 1: The Application Form
Start your journey by filling out our application form. This is your chance to introduce yourself and showcase your unique skills and experiences.
🏆 Step 2: The Challenge
Next up, tackle our challenge! This is where you can shine and show us how you approach and solve real-world problems.
💼 Step 3: The Technical Interview
Dive deep into your technical knowledge with our team. This is your opportunity to demonstrate your expertise and passion for the field.
🤝 Step 4: Cultural Fit & Compensation Chat
Meet with our COO to discuss our company culture and explore how you can thrive with us. We'll also discuss compensation to ensure we're on the same page.
🛠️ Step 5: 2-day trial
Put your skills to the test in a real-world hacking scenario. This trial helps us see your practical skills in action and how you handle challenges.
🔍 Step 6: The Reference Check & Offer
As a final step, we'll conduct a reference check to confirm your qualifications and past experiences. If all goes well, you will get an offer soon.
Exceptional candidates will hear from us as we advance through the recruitment process.
Zama values and promotes diversity. We give everyone a fair chance to be evaluated on their professional, academic, and personal skills. Our goal is to make the hiring process as pleasant, stress-free, and friendly as possible, even if it is longer and more involved than you might find elsewhere.

About

By leveraging Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE), it enables digital assets to be issued, managed, and traded privately on existing public blockchains such as Ethereum and Solana.
Founded by FHE pioneer Dr. Pascal Paillier and entrepreneur Dr. Rand Hindi, Zama brings together one of the world’s largest teams of FHE researchers and engineers and supports a global ecosystem of developers building confidential applications. zama.org
Job Description
Zama makes Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) practical at scale. The Zama Protocol brings FHE to blockchain, enabling confidential smart contracts on any L1 or L2. The Product Integrations team owns the Zama SDK, the high-level developer abstraction that lets wallets, custodians, exchanges, and dApps add confidential token support (ERC-7984) to their existing products without needing to understand the cryptography underneath.
The technology for using confidential tokens is live on Ethereum, with a roadmap to cover other EVM and non-EVM chains. Every serious partner conversation needs someone who can explain how confidential tokens work and answer the hard technical questions on the spot. The demand is coming from DeFi and on-chain finance protocols, from exchanges and custodians to stablecoin and tokenisation platforms and trading venues. Today that falls to a handful of people who cannot be in every call. We are looking for a Sales Engineer in our Product Division to be the person who can own the product/technical calls and whom the partners trust for a straight answer.
Product Integrations builds the tools and integrations that help external products use Zama technology: the Zama SDK, wallet and dApp integrations, and partner-facing developer workflows. This role sits inside the Product division, on the Product Integrations team, as the technical voice for the partners building on Zama. Day to day you will work with our Business Development and Ecosystem teams, who own the partner relationships and run most of these conversations, and with the Product Integrations and SDK engineers who build what you are selling.
What you'll do
Be the technical voice in partner conversations: Join partner and prospect calls as the product-side technical lead alongside our Business Development/Ecosystem team. Explain how Zama Protocol works to audiences that range from non-technical executives to sceptical protocol/chain engineers, and pitch it at exactly the right level for the room.
Run technical & product discovery: Qualify what a partner actually needs. Build a reusable discovery checklist and apply it across deals so real integration requirements get separated from noise early. Translate DeFi and on-chain finance use cases, from confidential transfers and trading to tokenised assets and stablecoins, into what the SDK can do.
Own the technical narrative: Build the decks, demos, and solution walkthroughs that make FHE tangible, and usable by the Product as well as Business Development/Ecosystem teams. Work out how a specific partner would use confidential tokens, then show them concretely how they would incorporate it into their product stack.
Answer the hard questions, accurately: Handle technical Q&A live in the room and in writing afterwards. Be precise about what the technology does and does not do. Credibility is the product.
Create bespoke demos to bring the product to life: Stand up demos and lightweight proof-of-concepts that let a partner see confidential tokens working in something close to their own context.
Close the loop with Product teams: Prioritise and surface partner objections, blockers, and feature gaps back to the Product Integrations and SDK team, so the product gets easier to sell with every deal.
Preferred Experience
8+ years in sales engineering, pre-sales, solutions consulting, or technical evangelism, with a track record in developer infrastructure, blockchain, wallets, custody, or fintech.
Exceptional communication. You can hold a room, read it, and move your pitch from boardroom to engineering workshop without losing accuracy.
Strong craft in decks, demos, and technical storytelling. You take pride in materials that land.
A gift for making hard technology clear, cryptography and confidential computing included, without burying people in detail.
Fluent in blockchain and the wallet/custodian space, and credible with partner product managers and engineers.
A working grasp of DeFi and on-chain finance. You can see how tokens, trading, settlement, custody, and stablecoins fit together, and where confidential tokens slot in.
The judgement and presence to represent Zama solo in senior, high-stakes conversations.
Comfort running many opportunities in parallel and prioritising your own time across them.
Nice-to-have
Direct experience with confidential or privacy-preserving blockchain tech (FHE, ZK, MPC), or a strong willingness to learn.
Time spent at a wallet, custody, exchange, on/off-ramp, or blockchain infrastructure company with knowledge of onchain/DeFi.
Experience selling or solutioning into banks, financial institutions, or regulated enterprises.
Comfortable reading a codebase, wiring up a demo, and talking engineer-to-engineer, even if you are not writing production code day to day.
